title: Uwo Ubwami Bupfukamye Imbere y’Ibimenyetso vyiwe
intro: Urugendo rudasanzwe rurindiriye abashobora gutorera umuti iyo nkuru y’akabanga. Mu mpapuro z’Ivyahishuriwe Yohana, hariho umukuru w’igihugu, iyo ahuye n’umuhanuzi, yari guhindura ihanga ryose. Uwo muntu yatwara ari ku ntebe y’ubwami iri kure, ayobowe n’imigenzo ya kera, gushika aho igihe kidasanzwe c’ukuri kw’Imana gihindura umutware n’ubwami ibihe bidahera. Woba uzohishura akaranga k’uwo mutima udasanzwe inkuru yawo ihuriza hamwe ibidasanzwe n’ivy’imbere cane?
clues: Naratwara ihanga ry’ubutunzi ryari hakurya y’amazi ya kure, rizwi cane kubera amatongo yacu be n’ingoro yacu ndende cane.
Ubukuru bwanje bwari uburengeye ubundi bwose, yamara ubwami bukomeye bwaje gutera umugere ukubaho kwacu nyene n’akaranga kacu.
Akanyoni gatoyi kari gafise ubutumwa budasanzwe, kandi ibitangaza vyakurikiye vyaciye bimenagura ivyo nari niyumvira vyose ku bijanye n’ububasha.
Igihe nabonye intebe y’ubwami ihindutse imbere y’amaso yanje, nari nzi ko ata muntu apfa yoshobora kugira ubushobozi nk’ubwo.
Naramenyesheje ku mugaragaro ko niyobokera Umukama umwe w’ijuru n’isi, nca ndaheba ivyo nari narakunda vyose.
Twebwe nk’ihanga, twarahevye ugusenga izuba kwa kera, maze twakira ukuri kwahinduye vyose.

trial.label: Ikigeragezo gikomeye
options: Kwakira ubutumwa bw'akabanga biciye ku nyoni idasanzwe
Intambara yo kurwanya ingabo z'Umuhanuzi Sulaymani .
Imyaka mirongo itatu y’amapfa akomeye n’ingorane .
trial.answer: Kwakira ubutumwa bw'akabanga biciye ku nyoni idasanzwe

location.label: Ahantu nyamukuru
options: Uruzi Nili rwo mu Misiri ya kera

outcome.label: Inyishu
options: Narongoye Umuhanuzi Sulaymani maze mba i Yeruzalemu .
Twarayobokeye Allah maze twakira ukwizera kw'ukuri .
Nasubiye ku ntebe yanje y'ubwami, mbandanya kuganza nka kera .
Iryo hanga ryarafashwe maze rijanwa mu bundi bwami .
outcome.answer: Twarayobokeye Allah maze twakira ukwizera kw'ukuri .

arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
verse: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]." (38:32)
